title: Anesthesia-related changes in information transfer may be caused by reduction in local information generation

title: Depth of anesthesia indicator using combination of complexity and frequency measures

title: A comparison of EEG signal dynamics in waking, after anesthesia induction and during electroconvulsive therapy seizures.

title: Interhemispheric differences in awake and sleep human EEG: a comparison between non-linear and spectral measures.

title: A fast and general method to empirically estimate the complexity of brain responses to transcranial and intracranial stimulations.
note: introduces PCIST (Perturbational Complexity Index based on State Transitions), a fast perturbational complexity measure (Category 8 in taxonomy). PCIST combines Singular Value Decomposition (dimensionality reduction to extract principal components) and Recurrence Quantification Analysis (state transition quantification) to measure spatiotemporal complexity of brain responses to perturbation. Formula: PCIST = Σ(ΔNSTn) where ΔNSTn is maximized weighted difference in state transitions between response and baseline at optimal threshold.
